summary: No use of Persona 3 / FES / Portable (P3P) data for any shipped rule: every pack record cites at least one Reload source, and 'mixed'-edition sources appear only as corroboration next to Reload sources. All pinned snapshots are genuinely Reload: the Steam pages are app 2161700 with Reload-only achievements (Shift, Theurgy, Twilight Fragments); the aqiu game-data files come from src/p3r/Content/Xrd777 (P3R's game files) and three re-fetched upstream copies are byte-identical; the CN guide and 3DM page contain Reload-only content (神通法, 黄昏碎片, 羁绊剧情, 结缘网站的字条). All 33 sha256 pins in SOURCES.json and all 40 local files cited by the pack match. Missing-person windows (9/12–10/3, 10/21–11/2) match Reload guides (P3P guides give 10/4 and 11/3); Tartarus floor ranges (Thebel 2–22F …) are Reload's, not FES's (2–16F …). The builder's --check and its 17 self-tests pass without modifying files. Notes: 12 web sources are not pinned, Reload guides disagree on a few weekday sets, and two evidence files use shared-edition pages as corroboration.

Empress's extra requirement (first place in an exam, per aqiu) is told to the player, not modelled (documented exception).
